module int8_mac (
    input  wire               clk,
    input  wire               rst,
    input  wire               en,
    input  wire signed [7:0]  a,
    input  wire signed [7:0]  b,
    output reg  signed [31:0] acc
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            acc <= 32'b0;
        end
        else if (en) begin
            acc <= acc + ($signed(a) * $signed(b));
        end
    end

endmodule
